"""Importable implementation module for the root ``jq`` executable."""

item.text: The current front end already distinguishes syntax/lexical failures and rejects constant non-string object keys, but variable references silently become `null`. I’m tightening parser-time scope tracking and label resolution so those references fail before any input is evaluated.
